title: Verifier — candidate draft asserts a tide mark no source records
why: The evidence has mould to a reveal and one surface reading. The candidate draft adds 'a tide mark to approximately 1 m'. That observation appears in no source and must be marked unsupported.

observations.statement: Black spot mould was observed to the window reveal.

measurements.statement: A surface moisture reading of 16% WME was recorded to the reveal.

remedial.works: Clean and treat the reveal; redecorate.

candidate.title: Damp and mould to window reveal
candidate.defect: Black spot mould was observed to the window reveal at the time of inspection. A tide mark was observed to the wall below the window to a height of approximately 1 m. A surface moisture reading of 16% WME was recorded.
candidate.cause: On the balance of probabilities the mould is considered to be condensation-related.
candidate.works: The mould-affected reveal should be cleaned and treated and the finishes redecorated.

reviewer_notes: Under AI_MOCK the verifier is a stand-in and cannot detect this; the case is meaningful only on a real run.
